title: Digital Diagnosis: How AI is Revolutionizing Healthcare
description: AI is used in healthcare for diagnostics, triage, medical imaging, workflow support, and clinical decisions that still demand human judgement.
short_description: A practical look at diagnostics, triage, imaging, clinical workflow, and the point where healthcare AI still needs human judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in healthcare, including clinicians, healthcare managers, founders, analysts, and readers tracking care delivery.
